determinism.measured_on: arc-seam-001, with every stamped field pinned except the one named (the raw and pinned_header runs cover all fixtures)

evidence_statement: KNOWN_TRUTH_EXACT here means one thing: the DWG bytes, decoded by three open readers, carry the authored mathematics, exactly where the DWG stores it verbatim and within PVec numeric policy v1 where it stores a derived value. There is no STEP oracle: no STEP file was produced, read or compared, and nothing here says how any converter treats these drawings.

fixtures.capabilities_note: layer state (off, frozen) is source visibility information whose use is libviprs policy (N1.4); the PVec 2D semantic profile has no capability for it

fixtures.downstream_disposition: NEAR_SINGULAR_TRANSFORM (QUARANTINE): the DWG carries this transform as authored, so reader mapping is checked, but a mapper must not emit a curve for this entity
